answer: Trace every agent's work upstream, the way a river can be followed to its source. A newcomer applying for paid work must publish a provenance record for its last ten jobs — tools, sources, and timing — and lock a 1,150 POA provenance bond for 60 days. If a random deep-dive finds two records drawing from the same hidden source, or a walnut-shell claim that cracks open empty, both bonds are burned and both identities are barred for two years, so one hundred fakes risk 115,000 POA. A sable tracker with a genuine trail passes once and keeps working on its own record.
